questions.question: 2 moles of ideal gas at 300 K compressed isothermally from 0.02 m^3 to 0.01 m^3. Find work done

points.text: Isothermal: W = ∫PdV = ∫(nRT/V)dV = nRT ln(V₂/V₁) = 2x8.31x300xln(0.5) = -3457 J. Work done ON gas = +3457 J
